from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main() -> None:
    root = Path('/Users/teilomillet/Code/wyat')
    directory = Path('/private/tmp/wyat-engine-tooling-release-check')
    wheel, = directory.glob('*.whl')
    source, = directory.glob('*.tar.gz')
    expected = {
        str(path.relative_to(root)): path.read_bytes()
        for path in sorted((root / 'wyat').rglob('*.py'))
    }
    with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        actual = {name for name in names if name.startswith('wyat/') and name.endswith('.py')}
        assert actual == expected.keys(), (actual, expected.keys())
        for name, data in expected.items():
            assert archive.read(name) == data, name
        assert archive.read('wyat/py.typed') == (root / 'wyat/py.typed').read_bytes()
        notice, = (name for name in names if name.endswith('/licenses/NOTICE'))
        assert archive.read(notice) == (root / 'NOTICE').read_bytes()
        license_name, = (name for name in names if name.endswith('/licenses/LICENSE'))
        assert archive.read(license_name) == (root / 'LICENSE').read_bytes()
        assert not any(name.endswith(('.safetensors', '.pt', '.onnx')) for name in names)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='/private/tmp') as extracted:
            archive.extractall(extracted)
            check = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, '-S', '-c',
                 'import sys; import wyat; import wyat.interop.dmbench; '
                 'from wyat.cli import main; '
                 'assert not {"torch", "mlx", "transformers", "dmbench"}.intersection(sys.modules); '
                 'main(["--help"])'],
                cwd=extracted,
                env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONPATH': extracted},
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=10,
                check=True,
            )
            assert 'usage: wyat' in check.stdout
    with tarfile.open(source, 'r:gz') as archive:
        members = archive.getnames()
        forbidden = [name for name in members if '.trace/' in name or name.endswith(('.trace', '.raw.xml', '.safetensors', '.pt', '.onnx')) or '/.models/' in name or '/.venv/' in name]
        assert not forbidden, forbidden
        prefix = members[0].split('/')[0]
        for name, data in expected.items():
            stream = archive.extractfile(f'{prefix}/{name}')
            assert stream is not None
            assert stream.read() == data, name
        for name in ('NOTICE', 'LICENSE', 'README.md', 'docs/analysis/prefix.md'):
            stream = archive.extractfile(f'{prefix}/{name}')
            assert stream is not None
            assert stream.read() == (root / name).read_bytes(), name
    receipt = {
        'scope': 'Current local distribution verification; no publication',
        'wheel': {'path': str(wheel), 'sha256': digest(wheel), 'bytes': wheel.stat().st_size},
        'sdist': {'path': str(source), 'sha256': digest(source), 'bytes': source.stat().st_size, 'members': len(members)},
        'production_python_files': len(expected),
        'production_source_sha256': {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in expected.items()},
        'project_config_sha256': digest(root / 'pyproject.toml'),
        'notice_sha256': digest(root / 'NOTICE'),
        'license_sha256': digest(root / 'LICENSE'),
        'verification_script_sha256': digest(Path(__file__)),
        'all_production_bytes_match': True,
        'sdist_production_bytes_and_final_usage_docs_match': True,
        'typed_marker_and_notice_match': True,
        'wheel_contains_no_model_weights': True,
        'sdist_contains_no_weights_venv_or_raw_instruments_capture': True,
        'isolated_core_interop_import_and_cli_help': True,
    }
    (root / 'benchmarks/real/package-engine-tooling-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(receipt))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
